falsifier: Directional-state and absolute-downtrend confirmation fails to make short gross PnL positive, leaves 2023 negative after doubled costs, or reduces aggregate gross edge below fifty basis points per turnover.
formation_horizon: 210 completed 8-hour returns with 54-bar momentum and short confirmation, 6-bar reversal, and 126-bar downside components
hypothesis: Residual ranks identify relative laggards but should only be sold short when the lagged router is directional and the coin's own medium-horizon price trend is negative; suppressing forced chop and stress shorts should preserve long alpha and remove squeeze-prone hedges.
